words.headline: Sunday Sign Wars: Posted-Parking Violations Nearly Triple to 1,088
words.blurb: Parking took over Sunday, with 3,337 complaints against a typical 2,676, led by 1,088 posted-sign violations. Mild weather in the 50s and 60s helped, too: no-heat calls fell to 647, less than half the usual 1,526.
words.card_line: Every curb spoken for, every sign ignored

boroughs.Bronx: Noise led with 659 complaints, edging out parking's 400.
boroughs.Brooklyn: Parking wars ruled with 1,496 complaints, about double its 756 noise calls.
boroughs.Manhattan: Noise topped the list at 677, more than double parking's 317.
boroughs.Queens: Parking wars won out with 1,022 complaints, ahead of 655 for noise.
boroughs.Staten Island: A near tie: 67 parking complaints against 64 for noise.
